rel:api.advisories.comment: L1: security advisories with the affected software, vulnerable range and first patched version (GHSA records; OSV used only to resolve aliases).
rel:api.advisories.name: advisories
rel:api.advisories.view_definition:
SELECT a.id AS advisory_id,
    a.display_name AS advisory,
    a.attributes ->> 'ghsa_id'::text AS ghsa_id,
    a.attributes ->> 'cve_id'::text AS cve_id,
    a.attributes ->> 'severity'::text AS severity,
    a.attributes ->> 'summary'::text AS summary,
    a.attributes ->> 'url'::text AS url,
    a.attributes ->> 'published_at'::text AS published_at,
    r.from_entity_id AS software_id,
    s.display_name AS software,
    s.kind AS software_kind,
    r.properties ->> 'affected_range'::text AS affected_range,
    r.properties ->> 'fixed_version'::text AS fixed_version,
    r.primary_claim_id AS claim_id,
    r.k_from AS learned_k
   FROM catalog.entity a
     LEFT JOIN catalog.relationship r ON r.to_entity_id = a.id AND r.kind = 'affected_by_advisory'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL
     LEFT JOIN catalog.entity s ON s.id = r.from_entity_id
  WHERE a.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND a.kind = 'security_advisory'::text AND a.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.agent_skills.name: agent_skills
rel:api.agent_skills.view_definition:
SELECT software_id,
    kind,
    software,
    slug,
    ecosystem,
    package_name,
    category,
    docs_url,
    repository_url,
    developers,
    maintainers,
    latest_release,
    latest_release_on,
    license,
    stars,
    downloads,
    mcp_hosting,
    mcp_auth,
    mcp_is_official,
    protocols,
    concepts,
    summary
   FROM api.software
  WHERE kind = 'agent_skill'::text;

rel:api.api_symbols.comment: L1: public symbols per repository release (R3), with how many docs sections document each symbol (R4).
rel:api.api_symbols.name: api_symbols
rel:api.api_symbols.view_definition:
SELECT n.id AS node_id,
    d.id AS document_id,
    d.attributes ->> 'repository'::text AS repository,
    d.attributes ->> 'release_tag'::text AS release_tag,
    d.attributes ->> 'package'::text AS package,
    n.attributes ->> 'qualified_name'::text AS qualified_name,
    n.attributes ->> 'kind'::text AS symbol_kind,
    n.attributes ->> 'signature'::text AS signature,
    n.attributes ->> 'module'::text AS module,
    (n.attributes ->> 'is_public'::text)::boolean AS is_public,
    (n.attributes ->> 'deprecated'::text)::boolean AS deprecated,
    n.attributes ->> 'docstring_head'::text AS docstring_head,
    n.attributes ->> 'path'::text AS path,
    (n.attributes ->> 'lineno'::text)::integer AS lineno,
    ( SELECT r_1.entity_id
           FROM content.unit_entity_role r_1
          WHERE r_1.node_id = n.id AND r_1.role = 'release'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS release_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM content.unit_link l
          WHERE l.to_node_id = n.id AND l.kind = 'documents'::text) AS docs_links
   FROM content.document d
     JOIN content.document_version v ON v.document_id = d.id
     JOIN content.document_representation r ON r.document_version_id = v.id
     JOIN content.document_node n ON n.representation_id = r.id
  WHERE d.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND d.document_type_code = 'api_surface'::text AND n.unit_kind = 'api_symbol'::text;

rel:api.benchmark_scores.comment: L1: current conditioned benchmark scores: subject, benchmark version and parent benchmark, harness, who measured (reported_by), cost, run date, with the claim locator id.
rel:api.benchmark_scores.name: benchmark_scores
rel:api.benchmark_scores.view_definition:
SELECT s.id AS segment_id,
    st.subject_entity_id AS subject_id,
    sub.display_name AS subject,
    sub.kind AS subject_kind,
    s.ref_entity_id AS benchmark_version_id,
    b.display_name AS benchmark_version,
    COALESCE(bb.id,
        CASE
            WHEN b.kind = 'benchmark'::text THEN b.id
            ELSE NULL::uuid
        END) AS benchmark_id,
    COALESCE(bb.display_name,
        CASE
            WHEN b.kind = 'benchmark'::text THEN b.display_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS benchmark,
    s.amount AS score,
    s.unit,
    s.payload ->> 'harness'::text AS harness,
    s.payload ->> 'setting'::text AS setting,
    s.payload ->> 'reported_by'::text AS reported_by,
    s.payload ->> 'source_kind'::text AS source_kind,
    (s.payload ->> 'cost_usd'::text)::numeric AS cost_usd,
    s.payload ->> 'run_date'::text AS run_date,
    (s.payload ->> 'n_tasks'::text)::integer AS n_tasks,
    s.payload ->> 'reasoning_effort'::text AS reasoning_effort,
    s.payload AS conditions,
    lower(s.valid_during) AS valid_from,
    s.k_from AS learned_k,
    s.created_at AS observed_at,
    s.primary_claim_id AS claim_id,
    s.belief,
    st.scope_key
   FROM temporal.segment s
     JOIN temporal.stream st ON st.id = s.stream_id
     JOIN catalog.entity sub ON sub.id = st.subject_entity_id
     LEFT JOIN catalog.entity b ON b.id = s.ref_entity_id
     LEFT JOIN catalog.relationship vr ON vr.from_entity_id = b.id AND vr.kind = 'version_of'::text AND vr.k_to IS NULL
     LEFT JOIN catalog.entity bb ON bb.id = vr.to_entity_id AND bb.kind = 'benchmark'::text
  WHERE s.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND st.kind = 'benchmark_score'::text AND s.k_to IS NULL;

rel:api.benchmarks.comment: L1: benchmarks with their versions, organizer, metric/score type and how many conditioned scores we hold from which reporters.
rel:api.benchmarks.name: benchmarks
rel:api.benchmarks.view_definition:
SELECT id AS benchmark_id,
    display_name AS benchmark,
    slug,
    attributes ->> 'organizer'::text AS organizer,
    attributes ->> 'metric'::text AS metric,
    attributes ->> 'score_type'::text AS score_type,
    attributes ->> 'domain'::text AS domain,
    (attributes ->> 'agentic'::text)::boolean AS agentic,
    attributes ->> 'canonical_url'::text AS canonical_url,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(v.display_name ORDER BY v.display_name) AS array_agg
           FROM catalog.relationship r
             JOIN catalog.entity v ON v.id = r.from_entity_id
          WHERE r.to_entity_id = b.id AND r.kind = 'version_of'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL AND v.kind = 'benchmark_version'::text), '{}'::text[]) AS versions,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.benchmark_scores sc
          WHERE sc.benchmark_id = b.id) AS score_count,
    ( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT sc.reported_by) AS array_agg
           FROM api.benchmark_scores sc
          WHERE sc.benchmark_id = b.id) AS reported_by_kinds
   FROM catalog.entity b
  WHERE tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND kind = 'benchmark'::text AND lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.claim_candidates.comment: L3/evidence: every claim with its path (deterministic_first_party = cheap path, L1_candidate = prose/media candidate awaiting verification), status, subjects and the document it was read from. Candidates are never facts.
rel:api.claim_candidates.name: claim_candidates
rel:api.claim_candidates.view_definition:
SELECT id AS claim_id,
    claim_type,
    statement,
    status::text AS status,
    structured ->> 'path'::text AS path,
    structured ->> 'source_role'::text AS source_role,
    (structured ->> 'subject_resolved'::text)::boolean AS subject_resolved,
    structured -> 'speakers'::text AS speakers,
    structured ->> 'attribution'::text AS attribution,
    structured ->> 'learned_at'::text AS learned_at,
    structured ->> 'agrees_with_first_party_claim'::text AS agrees_with_first_party_claim,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(s.entity_id) AS array_agg
           FROM evidence.claim_subject s
          WHERE s.claim_id = c.id)) AS subjects,
    ( SELECT x.document_node_id
           FROM evidence.extraction_record x
          WHERE x.claim_id = c.id
         LIMIT 1) AS document_node_id,
    ( SELECT d.canonical_title
           FROM evidence.extraction_record x
             JOIN content.document_node n ON n.id = x.document_node_id
             JOIN content.document_representation r ON r.id = n.representation_id
             JOIN content.document_version v ON v.id = r.document_version_id
             JOIN content.document d ON d.id = v.document_id
          WHERE x.claim_id = c.id
         LIMIT 1) AS document_title,
    created_at
   FROM evidence.claim c
  WHERE tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id();

rel:api.claim_conflicts.comment: Kept disagreements between a first-party claim and another statement (value, scope or subject ambiguity); never averaged away, reconciled only by an explicit decision.
rel:api.claim_conflicts.name: claim_conflicts
rel:api.claim_conflicts.view_definition:
SELECT x.id AS conflict_id,
    x.conflict_kind,
    x.detected_by,
    x.detected_at,
    a.id AS first_party_claim_id,
    a.statement AS first_party_statement,
    a.status::text AS first_party_status,
    b.id AS other_claim_id,
    b.statement AS other_statement,
    b.status::text AS other_status,
    b.structured ->> 'source_role'::text AS other_source_role,
    b.structured ->> 'provenance'::text AS other_provenance,
    ( SELECT r.outcome
           FROM evidence.conflict_reconciliation r
          WHERE r.conflict_id = x.id
          ORDER BY r.decided_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS reconciliation
   FROM evidence.claim_conflict x
     JOIN evidence.claim a ON a.id = x.claim_a_id
     JOIN evidence.claim b ON b.id = x.claim_b_id
  WHERE a.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id();

rel:api.compute_devices.comment: L1: accelerators and systems with first-party spec attributes (sparse figures flagged) and how many offerings run on them.
rel:api.compute_devices.name: compute_devices
rel:api.compute_devices.view_definition:
SELECT id AS device_id,
    display_name AS device,
    slug,
    attributes ->> 'vendor'::text AS vendor,
    attributes ->> 'device_class'::text AS device_class,
    (attributes ->> 'memory_gb'::text)::numeric AS memory_gb,
    (attributes ->> 'memory_bandwidth_tbps'::text)::numeric AS memory_bandwidth_tbps,
    (attributes ->> 'bf16_tflops'::text)::numeric AS bf16_tflops,
    (attributes ->> 'fp8_tflops'::text)::numeric AS fp8_tflops,
    (attributes ->> 'fp4_pflops'::text)::numeric AS fp4_pflops,
    (attributes ->> 'sparse_figures'::text)::boolean AS sparse_figures,
    (attributes ->> 'tdp_w'::text)::numeric AS tdp_w,
    attributes ->> 'interconnect'::text AS interconnect,
    attributes ->> 'form_factor'::text AS form_factor,
    attributes ->> 'released_on'::text AS released_on,
    attributes ->> 'spec_url'::text AS spec_url,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(d.id, 'manufactures'::text, 'incoming'::text) x(x))) AS manufacturers,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM catalog.relationship r
          WHERE r.to_entity_id = d.id AND r.kind = 'runs_on'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL) AS offering_count
   FROM catalog.entity d
  WHERE tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND kind = 'compute_device'::text AND lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.compute_offerings.comment: L1: compute offerings (instance types, serverless GPUs, sandboxes, TPU slices) with every current price row (meter × commitment × region) normalised to USD per GPU-hour where a GPU count is known.
rel:api.compute_offerings.name: compute_offerings
rel:api.compute_offerings.view_definition:
SELECT o.id AS offering_id,
    o.display_name AS offering,
    o.slug,
    o.attributes ->> 'offering_class'::text AS offering_class,
    o.attributes ->> 'provider_slug'::text AS provider_slug,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(o.id, 'provides_compute'::text, 'incoming'::text) x(x))) AS providers,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(o.id, 'runs_on'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS devices,
    (o.attributes ->> 'gpu_count'::text)::integer AS gpu_count,
    (o.attributes ->> 'vcpu'::text)::numeric AS vcpu,
    (o.attributes ->> 'memory_gb'::text)::numeric AS memory_gb,
    o.attributes ->> 'pricing_url'::text AS pricing_url,
    p.meter,
    p.commitment,
    p.region,
    p.amount,
    p.currency,
    p.unit,
    p.per,
    p.usd_per_gpu_hour,
    p.valid_from,
    p.learned_k,
    p.claim_id
   FROM catalog.entity o
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.payload ->> 'meter'::text AS meter,
            COALESCE(s.payload ->> 'commitment'::text, 'unknown'::text) AS commitment,
            s.payload ->> 'region'::text AS region,
            s.amount,
            s.currency,
            s.unit,
            s.payload ->> 'per'::text AS per,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.unit = 'USD_per_GPU_hour'::text THEN s.amount
                    WHEN (s.unit = ANY (ARRAY['USD_per_node_hour'::text, 'USD_per_hour'::text])) AND COALESCE((s.payload ->> 'gpu_count'::text)::numeric, (o.attributes ->> 'gpu_count'::text)::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN s.amount / COALESCE((s.payload ->> 'gpu_count'::text)::numeric, (o.attributes ->> 'gpu_count'::text)::numeric)
                    WHEN s.unit = 'USD_per_chip_hour'::text THEN s.amount
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS usd_per_gpu_hour,
            lower(s.valid_during) AS valid_from,
            s.k_from AS learned_k,
            s.primary_claim_id AS claim_id
           FROM temporal.segment s
             JOIN temporal.stream st ON st.id = s.stream_id
          WHERE st.subject_entity_id = o.id AND st.kind = 'offering_price'::text AND s.k_to IS NULL AND (upper_inf(s.valid_during) OR upper(s.valid_during) > now())) p ON true
  WHERE o.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND o.kind = 'compute_offering'::text AND o.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.concepts.comment: L1: concepts and techniques (RAG, context engineering, harness, sandbox, MCP, skills ...) with how many works discuss them, software implements them, guidance items explain them and our modules cover them.
rel:api.concepts.name: concepts
rel:api.concepts.view_definition:
SELECT id AS concept_id,
    kind,
    display_name AS concept,
    slug,
    attributes ->> 'component'::text AS component,
    attributes ->> 'level'::text AS level,
    COALESCE(attributes ->> 'description'::text, summary) AS description,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'about'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS works_about,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'instance_of_concept'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS instances,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'implements_technique'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS implementations,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM guidance.item_subject s
          WHERE s.entity_id = e.id) AS guidance_items,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT b.revision_id) AS count
           FROM authoring.revision_binding b
          WHERE b.entity_id = e.id AND b.relation = 'covers'::text) AS modules_covering
   FROM catalog.entity e
  WHERE tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND (kind = ANY (ARRAY['concept'::text, 'technique'::text])) AND lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.endpoints.comment: L1: API operations per captured specification version; diff two versions by logical key (method|path) through content.unit_change or api.changes_since.
rel:api.endpoints.name: endpoints
rel:api.endpoints.view_definition:
SELECT n.id AS node_id,
    d.id AS document_id,
    d.canonical_title AS api_document,
    v.version_label,
    v.published_at,
    n.attributes ->> 'method'::text AS method,
    n.attributes ->> 'path'::text AS path,
    n.attributes ->> 'operation_id'::text AS operation_id,
    n.attributes ->> 'summary'::text AS summary,
    n.attributes -> 'tags'::text AS tags,
    (n.attributes ->> 'deprecated'::text)::boolean AS deprecated,
    (n.attributes ->> 'parameter_count'::text)::integer AS parameter_count,
    n.attributes ->> 'family'::text AS family,
    n.logical_key,
    ( SELECT r_1.entity_id
           FROM content.unit_entity_role r_1
          WHERE r_1.node_id = n.id AND r_1.role = 'api'::text
         LIMIT 1) AS api_entity_id
   FROM content.document d
     JOIN content.document_version v ON v.document_id = d.id
     JOIN content.document_representation r ON r.document_version_id = v.id
     JOIN content.document_node n ON n.representation_id = r.id
  WHERE d.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND (d.document_type_code = ANY (ARRAY['openapi_spec'::text, 'api_reference'::text])) AND n.unit_kind = 'endpoint'::text;

    attributes ->> 'starts_on'::text AS starts_on,
    attributes ->> 'ends_on'::text AS ends_on,
    attributes ->> 'city'::text AS city,
    attributes ->> 'country'::text AS country,
    attributes ->> 'website_url'::text AS website_url,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'edition_of'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS series,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'organized_by'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS organizers,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'presented_at'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS talk_count,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(x.value) AS array_agg
           FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.attributes -> 'tracks'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) x(value)), '{}'::text[]) AS tracks
   FROM catalog.entity e

rel:api.mission_progress.name: mission_progress
rel:api.mission_progress.view_definition:
SELECT m.id AS mission_id,
    m.slug,
    m.goal,
    m.status,
    m.started_at,
    m.ended_at,
    count(w.id) AS work_items,
    count(w.id) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 'succeeded'::orchestration.work_item_status) AS succeeded,
    count(w.id) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 'failed'::orchestration.work_item_status) AS failed,
    count(w.id) FILTER (WHERE w.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::orchestration.work_item_status, 'ready'::orchestration.work_item_status, 'running'::orchestration.work_item_status])) AS outstanding,
    COALESCE(sum(u.cost_usd), 0::numeric) AS cost_usd,
    m.budget_cost_usd
   FROM orchestration.mission m
     LEFT JOIN orchestration.work_item w ON w.mission_id = m.id
     LEFT JOIN observability.usage_rollup u ON u.mission_id = m.id
  GROUP BY m.id;

    attributes ->> 'country_code'::text AS country_code,

    summary,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'develops'::text, 'outgoing'::text) related(related)) AS developed_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'offered_by'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS offering_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'employed_by'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS people_count,
    api.fact_amount(id, 'organization_headcount'::text) AS headcount
   FROM catalog.entity e
  WHERE tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND kind = 'organization'::text AND lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.papers.comment: L1: papers with authors, code, citing talks/papers, cited papers and the ingestion level (P0 reference / P1 digest / P2 full) with its recorded promotion decision (document linked through document_about_entity role primary).
rel:api.papers.name: papers
rel:api.papers.view_definition:
WITH doc AS (
         SELECT a.entity_id,
            d.id AS document_id,
            d.attributes,
            d.document_type_code,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.entity_id ORDER BY d.created_at DESC) AS rn
           FROM content.document_about_entity a
             JOIN content.document d ON d.id = a.document_id
          WHERE a.role = 'primary'::text AND (d.document_type_code = ANY (ARRAY['arxiv_paper'::text, 'conference_paper'::text, 'journal_article'::text, 'tech_report'::text, 'model_card'::text, 'system_card'::text, 'dataset_card'::text, 'research_report'::text]))
        )
 SELECT w.id AS paper_id,
    w.title,
    w.attributes ->> 'arxiv_id'::text AS arxiv_id,
    w.attributes ->> 'doi'::text AS doi,
    w.published_at,
    w.canonical_url,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'authored_by'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS authors,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'published_by'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS publishers,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'has_code'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS repositories,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'introduces_technique'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS techniques,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM catalog.relationship r
             JOIN catalog.entity t ON t.id = r.from_entity_id
          WHERE r.to_entity_id = w.id AND (r.kind = ANY (ARRAY['about'::text, 'cites'::text])) AND t.kind = 'talk'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL) AS talks_about,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM catalog.relationship r
          WHERE r.to_entity_id = w.id AND r.kind = 'cites'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL) AS cited_by_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM catalog.relationship r
          WHERE r.from_entity_id = w.id AND r.kind = 'cites'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL) AS cites_count,
    api.fact_amount(w.id, 'paper_citations'::text) AS citations,
    w.abstract,
    COALESCE(doc.attributes ->> 'ingestion_level'::text, w.attributes ->> 'ingestion_level'::text, 'P0'::text) AS ingestion_level,
    COALESCE(doc.attributes -> 'promotion'::text, w.attributes -> 'promotion'::text) AS promotion,
    doc.document_id,
    doc.document_type_code,
    w.attributes ->> 'publication_form'::text AS publication_form
   FROM catalog.work w
     JOIN catalog.entity e ON e.id = w.id
     LEFT JOIN doc ON doc.entity_id = w.id AND doc.rn = 1
  WHERE w.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND w.kind = 'paper'::text AND e.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.people.comment: L1: people with current affiliations (employed_by, as of now) and how many talks/works they presented or authored.
rel:api.people.name: people
rel:api.people.view_definition:
SELECT id AS person_id,
    display_name AS person,
    slug,
    attributes ->> 'title'::text AS title,
    attributes ->> 'profile_url'::text AS profile_url,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'employed_by'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS affiliations,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'presented_by'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS talk_count,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'authored_by'::text, 'incoming'::text) related(related)) AS work_count
   FROM catalog.entity e
  WHERE tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND kind = 'person'::text AND lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.protocol_versions.comment: L1: protocol revisions (MCP) with status, changelog, highlights and the software releases that implement them.
rel:api.protocol_versions.name: protocol_versions
rel:api.protocol_versions.view_definition:
SELECT v.id AS version_id,
    v.display_name AS version,
    p.display_name AS protocol,
    v.attributes ->> 'version_label'::text AS version_label,
    v.attributes ->> 'released_on'::text AS released_on,
    v.attributes ->> 'status'::text AS status,
    v.attributes ->> 'changelog_url'::text AS changelog_url,
    v.attributes ->> 'schema_url'::text AS schema_url,
    v.attributes -> 'deprecates'::text AS deprecates,
    v.attributes -> 'highlights'::text AS highlights,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(v.id, 'implements_protocol'::text, 'incoming'::text) x(x))) AS implemented_by
   FROM catalog.entity v
     JOIN catalog.relationship r ON r.from_entity_id = v.id AND r.kind = 'version_of'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL
     JOIN catalog.entity p ON p.id = r.to_entity_id AND p.kind = 'ai_protocol'::text
  WHERE v.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND v.kind = 'ai_protocol_version'::text AND v.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.registry_listings.comment: L1: servers listed in a registry with transports, namespace-inferred first-party flag and the registry's own status stream (official = registry validation, not vendor status).
rel:api.registry_listings.name: registry_listings
rel:api.registry_listings.view_definition:
SELECT r.id AS relationship_id,
    s.id AS server_id,
    s.display_name AS server,
    s.attributes ->> 'namespace'::text AS namespace,
    (s.attributes ->> 'first_party_inferred'::text)::boolean AS first_party_inferred,
    s.attributes -> 'transport'::text AS transports,
    s.attributes ->> 'latest_version'::text AS latest_version,
    s.attributes ->> 'repository_url'::text AS repository_url,
    s.attributes ->> 'registry_status'::text AS registry_status,
    g.display_name AS registry,
    r.properties,
    r.k_from AS learned_k,
    ( SELECT seg.status
           FROM temporal.stream st
             JOIN temporal.segment seg ON seg.stream_id = st.id
          WHERE st.subject_relationship_id = r.id AND st.kind = 'registry_listing_status'::text AND seg.k_to IS NULL
          ORDER BY (lower(seg.valid_during)) DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS current_status
   FROM catalog.relationship r
     JOIN catalog.entity s ON s.id = r.from_entity_id
     JOIN catalog.entity g ON g.id = r.to_entity_id
  WHERE r.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND r.kind = 'listed_in'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL AND g.kind = 'registry'::text;

rel:api.software.comment: L1: libraries, repositories, MCP servers, agent skills, products and protocols in one table with ecosystem, docs/repo links, developers, latest release, license, stars/downloads, MCP hosting/auth/official flags, protocols and concepts.
rel:api.software.name: software
rel:api.software.view_definition:
SELECT e.id AS software_id,
    e.kind,
    e.display_name AS software,
    e.slug,
    e.attributes ->> 'ecosystem'::text AS ecosystem,
    e.attributes ->> 'package_name'::text AS package_name,
    e.attributes ->> 'category'::text AS category,
    e.attributes ->> 'docs_url'::text AS docs_url,
    COALESCE(e.attributes ->> 'repository_url'::text, ( SELECT (((('https://'::text || (x.attributes ->> 'host'::text)) || '/'::text) || (x.attributes ->> 'owner'::text)) || '/'::text) || (x.attributes ->> 'name'::text)
           FROM catalog.entity x
          WHERE (x.id IN ( SELECT api.related(e.id, 'backed_by_repository'::text, 'outgoing'::text) AS related))
         LIMIT 1)) AS repository_url,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'develops'::text, 'incoming'::text) x(x))) AS developers,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'maintains'::text, 'incoming'::text) x(x))) AS maintainers,
    lr.version_label AS latest_release,
    lr.released_on AS latest_release_on,
    COALESCE(api.fact_payload(e.id, 'library_license'::text) ->> 'spdx'::text, e.attributes ->> 'license'::text) AS license,
    api.fact_amount(COALESCE(( SELECT api.related(e.id, 'backed_by_repository'::text, 'outgoing'::text) AS related
         LIMIT 1), e.id), 'repository_stars'::text) AS stars,
    api.fact_amount(e.id, 'package_downloads'::text) AS downloads,
    e.attributes ->> 'hosting'::text AS mcp_hosting,
    e.attributes ->> 'auth'::text AS mcp_auth,
    (e.attributes ->> 'is_official'::text)::boolean AS mcp_is_official,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'implements_protocol'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS protocols,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(e.id, 'instance_of_concept'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS concepts,
    e.summary
   FROM catalog.entity e
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.attributes ->> 'version_label'::text AS version_label,
            (r.attributes ->> 'released_on'::text)::date AS released_on
           FROM catalog.entity r
          WHERE r.kind = 'library_release'::text AND (r.id IN ( SELECT api.related(e.id, 'version_of'::text, 'incoming'::text) AS related))
          ORDER BY (r.attributes ->> 'released_on'::text) DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) lr ON true
  WHERE e.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND (e.kind = ANY (ARRAY['library'::text, 'repository'::text, 'mcp_server'::text, 'agent_skill'::text, 'product'::text, 'ai_protocol'::text])) AND e.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.software_releases.comment: L1/L2: every known release of a software thing with its date, breaking flag, highlights and the knowledge sequence it was learned at. Order by released_at for history.
rel:api.software_releases.name: software_releases
rel:api.software_releases.view_definition:
SELECT r.id AS release_id,
    r.display_name AS release,
    s.id AS software_id,
    s.display_name AS software,
    s.kind AS software_kind,
    r.attributes ->> 'version_label'::text AS version_label,
    COALESCE(( SELECT lower(o.occurred_during) AS lower
           FROM temporal.event e
             JOIN temporal.event_occurrence o ON o.event_id = e.id
          WHERE e.subject_entity_id = r.id AND e.kind = 'release_published'::text AND o.k_to IS NULL
          ORDER BY (lower(o.occurred_during))
         LIMIT 1), (r.attributes ->> 'released_on'::text)::timestamp with time zone) AS released_at,
    COALESCE((r.attributes ->> 'breaking'::text)::boolean, false) AS breaking,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(x.value) AS array_agg
           FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(r.attributes -> 'highlights'::text, '[]'::jsonb)) x(value)), '{}'::text[]) AS highlights,
    r.attributes ->> 'release_url'::text AS release_url,
    ( SELECT o.k_from
           FROM temporal.event e
             JOIN temporal.event_occurrence o ON o.event_id = e.id
          WHERE e.subject_entity_id = r.id AND e.kind = 'release_published'::text AND o.k_to IS NULL
         LIMIT 1) AS learned_k,
    r.created_at AS observed_at
   FROM catalog.entity r
     JOIN catalog.relationship rel ON rel.from_entity_id = r.id AND rel.kind = 'version_of'::text AND rel.k_to IS NULL
     JOIN catalog.entity s ON s.id = rel.to_entity_id
  WHERE r.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND r.kind = 'library_release'::text AND r.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.talks.comment: L1: conference talks with event, track, speakers and their affiliations, topics (about), linked repositories (has_code), recording and slides links.
rel:api.talks.name: talks
rel:api.talks.view_definition:
SELECT w.id AS talk_id,
    w.title,
    e.slug,
    w.attributes ->> 'talk_kind'::text AS talk_kind,
    w.attributes ->> 'track'::text AS track,
    w.attributes ->> 'level'::text AS level,
    ev.display_name AS event,
    ev.id AS event_id,
    ev.attributes ->> 'starts_on'::text AS event_starts_on,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'presented_by'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS speakers,
    ( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT org.display_name) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'presented_by'::text, 'outgoing'::text) sp(sp)
             JOIN catalog.relationship r ON r.from_entity_id = sp.sp AND r.kind = 'employed_by'::text AND r.k_to IS NULL
             JOIN catalog.entity org ON org.id = r.to_entity_id) AS speaker_affiliations,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'about'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS topics,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(x.x) AS array_agg
           FROM api.related(w.id, 'has_code'::text, 'outgoing'::text) x(x))) AS repositories,
    w.published_at AS recorded_at,
    w.duration_ms,
    w.canonical_url,
    w.attributes ->> 'video_url'::text AS video_url,
    w.attributes ->> 'slides_url'::text AS slides_url,
    w.attributes ->> 'session_id'::text AS session_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM content.document d
          WHERE d.work_entity_id = w.id OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM content.document_about_entity a
                  WHERE a.document_id = d.id AND a.entity_id = w.id AND a.role = 'primary'::text))) AS document_count,
    e.summary
   FROM catalog.work w
     JOIN catalog.entity e ON e.id = w.id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.id,
            x.tenant_id,
            x.kind,
            x.display_name,
            x.slug,
            x.summary,
            x.lifecycle,
            x.merged_into_id,
            x.projection_knowledge_seq,
            x.created_by_receipt_id,
            x.created_at,
            x.updated_at,
            x.attributes
           FROM catalog.entity x
          WHERE (x.id IN ( SELECT api.related(w.id, 'presented_at'::text, 'outgoing'::text) AS related))
         LIMIT 1) ev ON true
  WHERE w.tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id() AND w.kind = 'talk'::text AND e.lifecycle = 'active'::text;

rel:api.works_authored.comment: L1 (ours, tier 1): our courses, modules, lessons, activities, reports and templates at their head revision, whether released, which concepts they cover and which software/versions they use.
rel:api.works_authored.name: works_authored
rel:api.works_authored.view_definition:
SELECT w.id AS work_id,
    w.kind,
    w.slug,
    r.title,
    r.id AS head_revision_id,
    r.revision_no,
    w.workspace_id,
    ws.kind AS workspace_kind,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM authoring.release_item i
          WHERE i.revision_id = r.id AND (i.disposition = ANY (ARRAY['include'::text, 'snapshot'::text])))) AS released,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(b.entity_id) AS array_agg
           FROM authoring.revision_binding b
          WHERE b.revision_id = r.id AND b.relation = 'covers'::text AND b.entity_id IS NOT NULL)) AS covers_concepts,
    api.names(( SELECT array_agg(u.x) AS array_agg
           FROM ( SELECT b.entity_id AS x
                   FROM authoring.revision_binding b
                  WHERE b.revision_id = r.id AND b.relation = 'uses'::text AND b.entity_id IS NOT NULL
                UNION
                 SELECT q.entity_id
                   FROM authoring.runtime_requirement q
                  WHERE q.revision_id = r.id AND q.entity_id IS NOT NULL) u)) AS uses_software,
    ( SELECT array_agg((q.name || ' '::text) || COALESCE(q.version_spec, ''::text)) AS array_agg
           FROM authoring.runtime_requirement q
          WHERE q.revision_id = r.id) AS runtime_requirements,
    r.knowledge_seq,
    r.created_at,
    1::smallint AS source_tier
   FROM authoring.work w
     JOIN authoring.work_revision r ON r.id = w.head_revision_id
     JOIN authoring.workspace ws ON ws.id = w.workspace_id
  WHERE w.tenant_id = util.default_tenant_id() AND (w.kind = ANY (ARRAY['course'::text, 'track'::text, 'module'::text, 'lesson'::text, 'activity'::text, 'report'::text, 'project_template'::text, 'challenge'::text, 'component'::text, 'experience'::text]));

rel:orchestration.mission_run_effects.comment: Native effects by Mission Control run: intent (with its mc_* coordinates and origin digest) -> receipt -> receipt targets, for intents that carry mission coordinates. security_invoker: the caller's grants and tenant policies on the three tables apply, so only roles that can read operation_receipt (executor_service, control_plane) can read it.
rel:orchestration.mission_run_effects.name: mission_run_effects
rel:orchestration.mission_run_effects.view_definition:
SELECT i.tenant_id,
    i.mc_run_id,
    i.mc_mission_id,
    i.mc_activation_id,
    i.mc_operation_id,
    i.mc_operation_attempt,
    i.mc_execution_generation,
    i.mc_lane,
    i.origin_digest,
    i.id AS intent_id,
    r.id AS receipt_id,
    r.outcome AS receipt_outcome,
    r.applied_at,
    r.use_decision_id,
    t.ordinal,
    t.target_schema,
    t.target_table,
    t.target_id,
    t.entity_id,
    t.entity_kind,
    t.role,
    t.action,
    t.proposal_id,
    t.claim_id
   FROM orchestration.operation_intent i
     JOIN orchestration.operation_receipt r ON r.intent_id = i.id
     JOIN orchestration.operation_receipt_target t ON t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND t.receipt_id = r.id
  WHERE i.mc_run_id IS NOT NULL;

policies.name: bounded_role_access
policies.using:
((tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM retrieval.vector_item v
  WHERE ((v.id = vector_item_embedding_1536.vector_item_id) AND (v.lens <> 'private'::text)))))
policies.with_check:
((tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM retrieval.vector_item v
  WHERE ((v.id = vector_item_embedding_1536.vector_item_id) AND (v.lens <> 'private'::text)))))

policies.name: product_private_access
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM retrieval.vector_item v
  WHERE ((v.id = vector_item_embedding_1536.vector_item_id) AND (v.lens = ANY (ARRAY['private'::text, 'ours'::text])))))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM retrieval.vector_item v
  WHERE ((v.id = vector_item_embedding_1536.vector_item_id) AND (v.lens = ANY (ARRAY['private'::text, 'ours'::text])))))

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX use_admission_key ON verification.use_admission USING btree (tenant_id, use_decision_id, bound_effect_digest, xact_id, authoritative_epoch, normalized_values_digest) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
indexes.name: use_admission_key

rel:verification.use_admission.name: use_admission

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER use_admission_guard BEFORE INSERT ON verification.use_admission FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION verification.guard_use_admission()
triggers.name: use_admission_guard

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER use_admission_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON verification.use_admission FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION util.reject_mutation()
triggers.name: use_admission_immutable

acquisition.comment: How bytes were obtained: every product/harness/mission fetch is a ledger row before it becomes an evidence.source_capture. Search/provider attempts stay in evidence until the KS executor moves (deferred).
acquisition.name: acquisition

api.comment: Views and functions only. The sole surface exposed to apps and agents.
api.name: api

catalog.comment: Industry identities: one entity row per thing (kind + validated attributes), aliases, identifiers, merges, one relationship table, works (paper/talk/media/story/case study).
catalog.name: catalog

content.comment: Immutable authored-work identity, representations, structural nodes, transformations and conversion evaluation.
content.name: content

curriculum.comment: Learning paths, modules, lessons, challenges, knowledge mappings.
curriculum.name: curriculum

evaluation.comment: Datasets, cases, graders, runs, scores, gates, review queue.
evaluation.name: evaluation

evidence.comment: Sources, captures, locators, signatures, claims, support, verification. PROVISIONAL until the attribution lab stabilizes it.
evidence.name: evidence

guidance.comment: Expert engineering knowledge as typed items (problem, solution pattern, failure mode, compatibility constraint, operational practice, implementation example, security consideration, usage pattern) bound to entities and versions.
guidance.name: guidance

knowledge_service.comment: Restart-safe standalone operations, steps, events, leases, receipts, outbox and guarded review decisions.
knowledge_service.name: knowledge_service

observability.comment: Trace index, spans, raw/normalized events, I/O links, handoffs.
observability.name: observability

orchestration.comment: Missions, work graph, sessions, capability catalog, intents, receipts, artifacts.
orchestration.name: orchestration

ranking.comment: Metric definitions/observations, features, groups, policies, snapshots.
ranking.name: ranking

retrieval.comment: Vector spaces, vector catalog, retrieval plans/runs, evidence packets.
retrieval.name: retrieval

staging.comment: Typed candidates, discovery results, mentions, identity resolution.
staging.name: staging

taxonomy.comment: Versioned multi-facet taxonomies and their enforced assignments.
taxonomy.name: taxonomy

util.comment: Shared helper functions. Owns no domain tables.
util.name: util

verification.comment: Evidence acts 4-5: verification observations and use decisions admitted into this domain store (Knowledge Services is the shared engine; this is the admission ledger).
